description_en: Provides the server-side API for passive liveness detection
description_zh: 静默活体纯服务端能力Api
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl face-liveness --product-code FACE_LIVENESS_MIN --merchant-biz-id e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c353888 --merchant-user-id 123456789 --face-picture-url https://digital-face-prod8.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/1669520556530-expo/default/face/20221127114236530_w3kx2e6t.jpg --face-picture-base64 Base64 --face-quality T --crop T --occlusion T --face-quality-check Y --face-attribute-check example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: FaceLiveness

parameters.help_en: The merchant-defined unique business ID used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can contain letters and digits with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The merchant user ID or another identifier that can be used to identify a specific user, such as a phone number or email address. We strongly recommend that you desensitize the value of the userId field before passing it in, for example, by hashing the value
parameters.help_zh: 商户用户ID，或可用于识别特定用户的其他标识符，例如手机号码、电子邮件地址等。强烈建议对userId字段的值进行预脱敏处理，例如对该值进行hash处理
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face photo
parameters.name: face_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded face photo.

Note:
If you use FacePictureBase64 (Base64-encoded photo) to pass in the face photo, check the photo size and do not pass in an excessively large photo
parameters.help_zh:
照片Base64编码。

说明：
如果您选择FacePictureBase64（照片Base64编码）方式传入人脸照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: face_picture_base64

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to output the face quality score. Default value: F. Valid values:
T: enabled.
F: disabled. (Default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否输出人脸质量分，默认不允许，T/F
T：表示需要检测
F：表示需要检测（默认F）
parameters.name: face_quality

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow cropping. Default value: F. Valid values:

T: enabled.
F: disabled. (Default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许裁剪，默认不允许，T/F

T：表示需要检测
F：表示需要检测（默认F）
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform occlusion detection. Default value: F. Valid values:

T: enabled.
F: disabled. (Default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否进行遮挡检测，默认不允许T/F

T：表示需要检测
F：表示需要检测（默认F）
parameters.name: occlusion

Message.description_en: The description of the return result

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

FaceAge.description_en: The predicted reference age based on the face image. The prediction may fail, in which case no value is returned
FaceAge.description_zh: 人脸预测的参考年龄，可能存在预测失败无结果值的情况

FaceAttack.description_en: The liveness detection result. Valid values: Y (attack detected) and N (normal)
FaceAttack.description_zh: 活体检测结果，Y（攻击）/N（正常）

FaceGender.description_en:
The predicted gender based on the face image. The prediction may fail, in which case no value is returned. Valid values:

M: male.
F: female
FaceGender.description_zh:
人脸图片预测的性别，可能存在预测失败无结果值的情况。

M：男
F：女

FaceQualityScore.description_en: The face quality score (0 to 100). This value is returned only when the face quality score switch is enabled in the request parameters
FaceQualityScore.description_zh: 人脸质量分(0～100)，当且仅当入参质量分开关打开时返回

OcclusionResult.description_en: The occlusion detection result. Valid values: Y (occluded) and N (not occluded). This value is returned only when the occlusion detection switch is enabled in the request parameters
OcclusionResult.description_zh: 遮挡检测结果,Y (遮挡) /N (无遮挡),当且仅当遮挡检测开关打开时返回

Passed.description_en:
Indicates whether the authentication passed. Valid values:

Y: passed.
N: not passed
Passed.description_zh:
认证是否通过

Y：通过
N：不通过

TransactionId.description_en: The unique ID of the authentication request
